description: This file contains Go source code defining functions and methods for handling Protocol Buffers descriptors, including message, field, and extension management within the 'descriptor' package.

classes.name: DescriptorProto
classes.description: Represents a protocol buffer message descriptor, including options and extension ranges.

classes.name: FieldDescriptorProto
classes.description: Represents a field within a protocol buffer message, including type, label, options, and methods to determine field properties.

classes.name: FileDescriptorProto
classes.description: Represents a file descriptor for a protocol buffer, including message types, enums, extensions, and syntax.

classes.name: FileDescriptorSet
classes.description: A set of file descriptors, providing methods to retrieve messages, enums, extensions, and nested types.

classes.name: EnumDescriptorProto
classes.description: Represents an enum type in a protocol buffer file.

methods.name: GetMapFields
methods.description: Returns the key and value fields of a map entry message if applicable.

methods.name: dotToUnderscore
methods.description: Converts a dot character to an underscore, used for package name transformations.

methods.name: WireType
methods.description: Determines the wire type for a given field based on its type.

methods.name: GetKeyUint64
methods.description: Generates a uint64 key for a field, considering packing and wire type.

methods.name: GetKey3Uint64
methods.description: Generates a uint64 key for a field with a different packing method.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key as a byte slice for a field.

methods.name: GetKey3
methods.description: Returns the key as a byte slice for a field with alternative packing.

methods.name: GetField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field descriptor from a message given package, message, and field names.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message descriptor from a file or nested message given package and message name.

methods.name: GetNestedMessage
methods.description: Recursively retrieves nested message descriptors.

methods.name: IsProto3
methods.description: Checks if a message type in a file uses proto3 syntax.

methods.name: IsExtendable
methods.description: Determines if a message descriptor has extension ranges.

methods.name: FindExtension
methods.description: Finds an extension field by name for a given message type.

methods.name: FindExtensionByFieldNumber
methods.description: Finds an extension field by field number for a given message type.

methods.name: FindMessage
methods.description: Finds a message type associated with a field, considering extensions.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves a field descriptor from a message by field name.

methods.name: GetEnum
methods.description: Retrieves an enum descriptor from a file given package and type name.

methods.name: IsEnum
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is of enum type.

methods.name: IsMessage
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is of message type.

methods.name: IsBytes
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is of bytes type.

methods.name: IsRepeated
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is repeated.

methods.name: IsString
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is of string type.

methods.name: IsBool
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is of boolean type.

methods.name: IsRequired
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is required.

methods.name: IsPacked
methods.description: Checks if a field descriptor is packed.

methods.name: IsPacked3
methods.description: Checks if a repeated scalar field is packed with a different method.

methods.name: HasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a message descriptor has extension ranges.
